constraints.translation: Isabella had been working hard on her project
If Isabella finished her project on time, then Isabella receives a bonus from her company
constraints.reasoning: Explicit conditional embedded in the text ('if she finished it on time, she would receive a bonus').

constraints.translation: Isabella hoped to receive a bonus

constraints.translation: If Isabella fails to receive a bonus from her company, then Isabella does not receive a bonus from her company

constraints.translation: If Isabella does not receive a bonus from her company, then Isabella fails to receive a bonus from her company
constraints.reasoning: Definitional relation in the reverse direction to align P_4 with the negation of P_3.
